text:
Leah (Finance): Heads up — Brightline Health dispute on invoice INV-89021. They were billed for 2.2M tokens in Jan but claim 1.6M should have been attributed to a sandbox project. Requesting one-time credit of $38,400 to cover the overcharge. Details below.

Ashwin (Sales): Confirming — customer escalated to CSM. We promised to review quickly; they're at risk of pausing. I support the one-time credit to preserve the relationship.

Maya Ops: Quick root cause: a job from their dev team used the production API key for ~18 hours due to a CI misconfig. We archived traces: `req_id: a7f3c9` and the usage spike aligns with 2026-02-04 03:00-21:00 UTC. We're patching the onboarding doc to warn about environment variables.

Leah (Finance): Numbers: billed amount = $48,000 (for that window). Customer is requesting $38,400 (80% refund) because they accept partial responsibility. My ask: approval to issue a one-time credit of `-$38,400` and mark as "Customer Goodwill - Billing Exception". Impact to recognized revenue for Feb: reduce by $38.4k (deferred adj). Approver?

deal-desk-bot: Approval path: requests > $25k require Deal Desk + Revenue ops sign-off + Legal timestamped amendment. Current check: finance approved?

Sofia (Revenue): FYI — revenue impact OK as one-time adjustment under AR write-downs. Need GL code: `6205` and memo referencing `INV-89021` and `CS-762`. Also flag for audit trail.

Tom (Legal): We need a short amendment to the Master Services Agreement only if we convert this to a credit that converts into committed discount or changes terms. For a one-time credit, a signed amendment is not necessary, but please save the customer's email acceptance (CS confirmation) and attach to the credit memo.

Ashwin (Sales): I'll get the CS note. CSM Sarah confirmed customer accepts one-time credit if we provide assurance the issue is fixed. I'll post the acceptance here: "Brightline accepts $38,400 one-time credit; will not pursue further claims if remediation confirmed."

Maya Ops: Confirm remediation deployed, added server-side check to prevent prod key in CI. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1224.

Leah (Finance): Requested approvals: Finance (Leah) ✅, Revenue (Sofia) ✅, Legal (Tom) advisory — noted. Need Deal Desk final sign-off to process >$25k.

deal-desk-bot: Routing to Deal Desk approvers: @ashwin (owner), @Leah (finance), @Sofia (revenue), @Tom (legal). Please react with :thumbsup: to approve within 48h or escalate.

Tom (Legal): :thumbsup: (advisory ok) — preserve CS acceptance in ticket.

Ashwin (Sales): :thumbsup: Approved from sales side. We'll capture acceptance email and attach.

Leah (Finance): Finalizing: I'll create credit memo CM-2026-0047 and post to accounting. Posting Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-6327 (billing-exception/brightline). Will mark memo with GL `6205` and attach CS email + PR link.

Sofia (Revenue): :thumbsup: Recording in revenue ops. Please cc me on the memo for close.

Maya Ops: Noted. I'll follow up with product to update the quickstart to avoid recurrence.

Leah (Finance): Thanks everyone — proceeding to issue `-$38,400` credit next business day after CS acceptance captured. If anything changes please flag here.
